caption: The drawing features a long-sleeved, floor-length dress with a high neckline and a fitted bodice, rendered in shades of light gray with blue decorative accents. The dress is adorned with vertical blue lines that run from the shoulders down to the waist and skirt, and has blue decorative trim along the cuffs, collar, and hem. There are curved blue patterns and stylized leaf or floral motifs on the skirt and sleeves, as well as blue buttons down the front of the bodice. The dress has a waistband that matches the blue trim. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, less detailed sketch in gray showing the back view of the same dress, which includes a bow at the waist and additional blue trimming on the skirt. The background is a plain, beige color with no additional objects depicted.
title: Dress
